messages:
Arjun - Eng Manager: Hey @people-ops — quick: Luca finished a high-impact project before transferring org and asks for mid-cycle leveling. Transfer date is inside the promo window. Can we bridge with a bonus if leveling can't be approved?
Tess - People Ops: Short: yes, we can use a spot or off-cycle increase as a bridge, but leveling still needs calibration. Please submit evidence + transfer dates.
Luca - IC: For context: led rollout that cut p99 by 22% and reduced infra cost ~11k/mo. Most work done on Arjun's team; transfer official on 2026-06-15.
Tess - People Ops: Submit the packet with both manager sign-offs (old + new) and note "mid-cycle transfer". If calibration denies level move, comp + people-ops will recommend either spot bonus or off-cycle increase depending on durability of change.
Mina - Payroll: Operational note: spot bonuses under 5% of annual salary only need people-ops sign-off; >5% requires comp approval. Deadlines: comp sign-off by 2026-06-20 23:59 UTC; payroll file due 2026-06-23 18:00 PT. Missed file = retro next cycle.
Arjun - Eng Manager: If we pick a spot bonus, can we backdate effective date to the transfer?
Mina - Payroll: Cash payments can be documented as retro to transfer date, but money arrives based on payroll run. We include a detailed retro statement in the notification.
Levelling Bot: Reminder: leveling-exception form at https://intranet.redwood/hr/leveling-exceptions. Submit 48h before calibration for guaranteed review.
Luca - IC: If leveling is approved later, will base and equity adjust retroactively?
Tess - People Ops: Base salary can be updated retroactively with payroll adjustments; equity grants follow their own cadence (next grant cycle) — we'll note both in the approval memo.
Arjun - Eng Manager: Any templates for the evidence packet?
Tess - People Ops: Use this short checklist: 1) one-paragraph summary of contribution, 2) metrics + links, 3) PRs/reviews, 4) old + new manager endorsements, 5) suggested effective date and budget owner. Ping me and I'll pre-check before submission.
Mina - Payroll: Also include employee ID in the form to avoid delays.
Tess - People Ops: Thanks — I'll stand by to help. Thread closed pending packet submission.
